description:
Remove areas of pages for good. A page with an area becomes a picture of itself with the areas
painted over, so its text can no longer be selected or searched; the other pages stay as they
are. The bookmarks, attachments, form list and document information go too. Takes pdf files. Needs Ghostscript.

PageArea.description:
An area of the pages, in points from the top left corner of the page as it is shown (72 points
are an inch; `inspect` gives each page's size).

pages.description: The pages it applies to, e.g. `1,3-5`. Empty: every page.

x.description: Left edge, in points from the left.

y.description: Top edge, in points from the top.

dpi.description: How sharp the pages that become pictures are, 72 to 600 dots per inch.

output_dir.description: Absolute folder for the results; default: the user's setting.

name: pdf_redact
title: Redact
